## Restricted permutations with R

[![CRAN
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/permute)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=permute)
[![](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/permute)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=permute)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/gavinsimpson/permute/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gavinsimpson/permute/actions)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/gavinsimpson/permute/graph/badge.svg?token=2FYEfBBSJ7)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/gavinsimpson/permute)

## What is permute?

**permute** generates permutations from a range of restricted
permutation designs.

Permute provides an R implementation of the permutation schemes
developed by Cajo ter Braak and made available in the Canoco software,
version 3.1 (ter Braak, 1990). These permutation schemes draw upon ideas
from an earlier paper by Besag & Clifford (1989).

Several types of permutation are available in **permute**:

- Free permutation of objects
- Time series or line transect designs, where the temporal or spatial
  ordering is preserved.
- Spatial grid designs, where the spatial ordering is preserved in both
  coordinate directions
- Permutation of plots or groups of samples.
- Blocking factors which restrict permutations to within blocks. The
  preceding designs can be nested within blocks, allowing analysis of
  hierarchical designs (e.g. split plot designs)

### References

Besag, J. and Clifford, P. (1989) Generalized Monte Carlo significance
tests. *Biometrika* **76**; 633–642.

ter Braak, C. J. F. (1990). *Update notes: CANOCO version 3.1*.
Wageningen: Agricultural Mathematics Group. (UR).

# Package index

## Generate permutations

High-level functions for drawing one or more restricted permutations, or
applying them directly to a vector.

- [`shuffle()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/shuffle.md)
  [`permute()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/shuffle.md)
  [`permutator()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/shuffle.md)
  : Unrestricted and restricted permutations
- [`shuffleSet()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/shuffleSet.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<permutationMatrix>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/shuffleSet.md)
  : Generate a set of permutations from the specified design
- [`permutations()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/permutations.md)
  [`print(`*`<permutations>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/permutations.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<permutations>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/permutations.md)
  : Permute a vector of data

## Define and inspect permutation designs

Create permutation designs, count the possible permutations, and check
designs for problems.

- [`how()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/how.md)
  [`Within()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/how.md)
  [`Plots()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/how.md) :
  How to define a permutation design?
- [`numPerms()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/numPerms.md)
  : Number of possible permutations for a given object
- [`check()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/check.md)
  [`summary(`*`<check>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/check.md)
  : Utility functions for permutation schemes

## Complete enumeration and fixed-size partitions

Enumerate complete permutation sets or generate assignments to groups of
fixed size.

- [`allPerms()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/allPerms.md)
  [`summary(`*`<allPerms>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/allPerms.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<allPerms>`*`)`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/allPerms.md)
  [`as.allPerms()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/allPerms.md)
  : Complete enumeration of all possible permutations
- [`allPartitions()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/partitions.md)
  [`shufflePartition()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/partitions.md)
  [`shufflePartitionSet()`](https://gavinsimpson.github.io/permute/reference/partitions.md)
  : Generate random assignments to groups of fixed size

Supporting APIs for package authors and advanced users working with
permutation designs.
